acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: A repo-native policy or design artifact records the selected private distribution channel, supported install command shape, version/ref semantics, update source, non-public boundary, and explicit out-of-scope publishing behavior.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: test/private-install-update-channel.test.mjs expects .bandit/policy/private-install-update-channel.json plus private-install/update templates in the package dry-run file list. Current package does not provide that distribution policy/template surface.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: The package can be installed into a fresh private consumer repo from the selected private channel and bandit init exits successfully without relying on this development checkout's existing node_modules.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: test/private-install-update-channel.test.mjs packs the current package, installs it in a fresh temp consumer repo, and runs the installed bandit bin. Current installed execution fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for package-local tsx.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Package contents are intentionally scoped for CLI distribution; packed artifacts exclude unrelated active work history, tests, large design prototypes, or repo-local workflow state unless explicitly justified as install-time templates or defaults.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: test/private-install-update-channel.test.mjs inspects npm pack --dry-run --json and rejects .bandit/events.jsonl, .bandit/bootstrap-gaps.json, docs/work/**, and test/**. Current package includes 887 non-distribution files.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: The CLI runtime no longer depends on a devDependency-only tsx loader in installed packages, or the selected build path otherwise proves installed CLI execution works from a packed/private install.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: The packed-install smoke test fails before init because bin/bandit.mjs imports node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs from the installed package, where devDependencies are absent.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Installed repos can run bandit update-check or equivalent to compare their installed Bandit version/ref against the configured private update source and receive deterministic current, update_available, unconfigured, unreachable, or disabled status.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: test/update-channel.test.mjs covers unconfigured, current, update_available, disabled, and unreachable states with --json. Current CLI returns Unknown command: update-check.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Normal CLI commands emit a concise non-blocking update alert only when update checking is configured and a newer private release is known. Failed update checks do not block the requested command and do not mask the command's own exit status.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: test/update-channel.test.mjs writes a fresh update_available cache, reruns init, and expects stderr to include Bandit update available without changing the command's exit status; current stderr is empty.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Update checks are freshness-bounded and cache their last successful result so ordinary Bandit commands do not perform unbounded network work on every invocation.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: test/update-channel.test.mjs expects update-check to write .bandit/update-channel-cache.json and normal commands to use a fresh cached update_available result. Current command/cache behavior is absent.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Update metadata is repo-local, reviewable, and data-minimal; it does not send telemetry, repo contents, workflow state, or user activity to any external service.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: test/update-channel.test.mjs recursively rejects telemetry, repo_contents, workflow_state, user_activity, package_usage, model_call_metadata, review_packets, and hidden_identifier keys from update-check output and cache.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: The install/update channel includes explicit commands or docs for updating an installed repo, such as npm install -D <private-source>@<tag> or the selected equivalent. Automatic self-update remains out of scope unless separately approved.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: test/update-channel.test.mjs expects update_available JSON/cache to carry an explicit npm install -D command from the private release manifest, not a self-mutating updater.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: The implementation preserves Bandit's CLI authority, repo-native canonical artifacts, supply-chain gate expectations, layered risk classification, operator fail-closed boundary, Permanent Test Ownership Boundary, and Bootstrap Model-Family Separation.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Codex authored test/private-install-update-channel.test.mjs, test/update-channel.test.mjs, and this RED evidence.
